verdict.rationale: Bento's docs say every span is captured over OpenTelemetry. You can point a standard OTel exporter at a single Bento endpoint with one auth header, even from TypeScript with no Bento package, and the Python SDK can plug into an existing OTel pipeline as its transport. This covers the core of using OTLP instead of a proprietary format. Missing for 10: OTLP protocol details are unclear (only JSON emission is mentioned for JS, with no word on protobuf or gRPC); there is no documented way to export traces back out of Bento over OTLP; there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
